Name: Pet Renamer
Author: irocendar
Description:
Rename your pets without manually editing your save. Compatible with multiple pets.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Stand next to the pet you want to rename, facing it.
[*]Click the mod key (by default, Delete) on your keyboard.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.
[*]Works in single player. Not tested in multiplayer yet.
[/list]

[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/irocendar/PetRenameMod]Source code[/url]
[/list]
